description.text: Interpretation: concentrated technology strength alongside weaker broad/cyclical participation reduces confidence in a broad rebound. Bull case: improving demand with easing yield pressure. Bear case: strong activity keeps financing costs elevated. Disconfirmation: improving equal-weight/small-cap participation and sustained lower yields. Review through Oct9; no numerical weekly prediction is validated.

NO TRADE: adjusted price history, executable rules, costs, liquidity and risk limits are not validated. Collect these before paper-trade evaluation.
